name: Depth cameras
short: Depth cameras: Orbbec, Kinect v1/v2, Azure Kinect, Intel RealSense, Oak3DVision and Luxonis OAK
long: Streams color, infrared, metric depth, IMU and point clouds from depth cameras, with per-camera calibration (intrinsics, distortion, extrinsics), timestamps, GPU positions/normals/mesh outputs and the camera's own controls, filters and presets. Camera SDKs come from the depth-camera package.
